description: This file defines a singleton object 'StringUtils' providing utility functions 'join' and 'split' for string and LinkedList manipulations, delegating to 'JoinUtils' and 'SplitUtils'.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins a LinkedList into a String using JoinUtils.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList using SplitUtils.
